"I didn't know a toddler made entirely of pasta could teach me how to cook dinner tonight... 😳🍝" Talk about an existential cooking show! 🍝✨ Meet this incredibly detailed Spaghetti Baby hosting her very first kitchen tutorial. Watch her carefully unwrap the instant package, secure the pasta bundle, and pop it right into the boiling water!  The way her little eyes light up and she bursts into the most heartwarming giggle when the noodles start cooking is the exact vibe we need today. 🥹❤️ The texture on her noodle hair is absolutely top-tier!
